entries.title.tagline: Grimsby Prep has invaded Maplecrest High. Rescue classmates, secure classrooms, train your hero squad and hold the Main Hall.

entries.difficulty.varsity.tooltip: The intended challenge. Grimsby focuses fire, kites, flanks your rooms and patches up in its own.
entries.difficulty.legend.tooltip: Tougher, faster invaders with Grimsby's full playbook: regroups, all-in rushes and leading rocket shots.

entries.room.main_hall.blurb: The heart of Maplecrest High. Trains Hall Monitors and fires spirit stars at nearby invaders. If it falls, the school is captured.
entries.room.gym.blurb: Trains Stretch, the rubber-limbed bruiser who knocks invaders back.
entries.room.chem_lab.blurb: Trains Blaze, the fire-power striker whose attacks splash nearby foes.
entries.room.cafeteria.blurb: Trains Frost, the ice-shield tank who protects nearby allies.
entries.room.library.blurb: Trains Psi, the telekinetic controller who slows and lifts foes.
entries.power.monitor.desc: Sprints at double speed for a few seconds. Perfect for grabbing stranded classmates.
entries.power.blaze.desc: Hurls a fireball at the nearest invader group for heavy splash damage.
entries.power.frost.desc: Shields every nearby hero, cutting incoming damage by 60% for 5 seconds.
entries.power.psi.desc: Lifts a group of invaders into the air, stunning them and pulling them together.
entries.power.stretch.desc: Slams the ground, damaging and knocking back every nearby invader.

entries.help.title: HOW TO PLAY
entries.help.loop: Grimsby Prep is trying to capture Maplecrest High. Rescue classmates shouting HELP! to earn Reputation, secure classrooms to unlock new hero types and raise your squad limit, then spend Reputation to train heroes and counter each invasion wave. Survive every wave and defeat the Mecha-Mascot to win. If the Main Hall falls, the school is captured.
entries.help.controls_body:
Left-click / drag: select heroes (Shift adds, double-click selects the same type)
Right-click: move or attack; with a room selected, sets its rally point
E then left-click: attack-move  ·  C: stop  ·  Q: use powers  ·  G: Spirit Surge
F: all heroes  ·  H: Main Hall  ·  T: train  ·  X: cancel training
R: Pep Rally  ·  B: ring the bell early for bonus Reputation
Ctrl+1-5: assign squad  ·  1-5: recall (twice to jump)
WASD / arrows / screen edge / middle-drag: pan  ·  Wheel: zoom
Space: jump to selection  ·  Esc: pause  ·  M: mute
Touch: tap to select, tap ground to attack-move, drag to pan, pinch to zoom

entries.help.tactics_body:
- Classmates stranded across campus are worth Reputation, but invaders hunt them too. Send fast Hall Monitors.
- Each secured classroom adds income and squad slots. Grimsby will try to retake rooms, so leave a defender or come back quickly.
- Red rings mark where the next wave enters. Meet invaders on the paths before they reach the Main Hall.
- Save Pep Rally for big fights. It heals every hero and repairs the Main Hall.
- Mix roles: Frost shields the front line, Psi groups enemies, and Blaze and Stretch clean up.
entries.cmd.surge_tooltip: When the Hype meter is full: every hero gains speed and power, cooldowns reset and the Main Hall glows. Build Hype by defeating invaders, chaining combos, rescuing and securing rooms.
entries.help.controls_touch:
Tap a hero card: select that hero type (double-tap to jump the camera)
Tap a hero on the field: select · Drag: pan · Pinch: zoom
Tap the ground or an invader: move / attack with the selection
ALL: select every hero · POWER: fire ready powers · ATTACK: next tap attack-moves
RALLY: heal everyone · SPIRIT SURGE: spend a full Hype meter
Tap a room on the sticky note to train heroes there
Tap the polaroid map to move the camera
